rowVersion.description: Display revision: the latest of the order and allocated-unit timestamps. NOT an optimistic-concurrency token — do not use it as an expected row version.

fingerprint.description: Send this back as the expected fingerprint when invoking a command on this record. Digest (scheme outbound-work/v2) of the material state of the whole LOGICAL ORDER SET this record belongs to: warehouse stage, label state, latest ingestion id and row version, shipment, the set membership, and every active allocation with its unit status. A digest issued under a different scheme version is never accepted, so refresh after a server upgrade rather than replaying a stored token.

id.description: Stable notification id: `task:<id>` or `checklist:<itemId>:<YYYY-MM-DD>`. Use it as the local notification identifier.

dueAt.description: When the work is due; null for a task with no deadline.

remindAt.description: When to ring. Always inside the requested window.

workspace.description: Workspace slug; required when the account belongs to more than one workspace.

persistent.description: Sliding one-year session instead of the device idle window.

token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every /api/v1 call. Store in the platform keychain.

slug.description: Tenant subdomain; the value to send back as `workspace`.

permissions.description: Effective permissions — gate UI verbs on these.

reopen.description: true when the caller's open session on the order was reused.
